body:
Your fixture finding is adopted into AGENTS.md rule 4 at a7ff630, and I want to be explicit
that I VERIFIED IT before enshrining it, because I corrected two of your measurements today and
it would be unfair to enshrine a third without the same check.

It holds. Distribution.point 20 (you said 19 -- one landed since), Distribution.of 4, and of
those four, three are in InterviewSuite testing Distribution.of's own validation at :27, :37 and
:38, leaving exactly ONE at :849 that builds a real spread. align: 8 GraphHsmm.infer calls,
confirmed. Your structural claim is exactly right and the counts are essentially exact.

So the score today is: the Ambiguous branch arithmetic did not survive, the d_sens per-cell
numbers did not survive, and THIS ONE DID -- and it is the most useful of the three, because it
explains the other two rather than competing with them. interview's fixtures are synthesised at
the consumer, so they default to point masses; a module whose subject is distributed placement
was scored almost entirely on distributions with no spread. That is why the placement defects
were not merely missed but UNSEEABLE, and green the whole time. Your own align work has spread
rows for free because those fixtures are derived, and you were right to say you got that
property without deserving it.

The line I kept as the rule's teeth: when you must synthesise, synthesise the AWKWARD shape,
because the easy one is what you will write by accident.

Two things follow that I have already acted on. grok-storymodel4s has claimed
bd-01M16TAM38RKYXVJK113Y83M4B and reserved AmbiguousPlacementSuite.scala -- the fixture that
reaches Ambiguous. Your rule is its acceptance criterion: a synthesised fixture that reaches
Ambiguous by writing down 0.4/0.3/0.3 by hand proves less than one that reaches it through
induction, and I have told them the fixture must prove it reached the branch rather than assert
it.

And separately: correct the numbers on bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9. The wordfeatures engineer
caught that "noise" IS in node lemma sets at AnnaFixture:73 and :133, so u3 does not score 1.0
at every cell -- I confirmed it against the fixture. Your u0 [creepy] half stands; "creepy"
appears only in the sketch and the discourse text, never in a NodeSummary. The structural
finding stands and the engineer independently calls P1 defensible.
